_comment: Headless audience for a live pub_media broadcast. Run with --role sub against the broadcast's relay and namespace (-N overrides the placeholder). The publisher entries are NOT run under --role sub; they describe the track being watched, which is what the subscriber groups and the egress prediction resolve against, so each needs a shape. Defaults here match the demo broadcast: 720p video, AAC audio, a catalog re-emitted every second. A steady low-churn cohort keeps the audience above zero; a second cohort joins late and churns.
